summary: Responsive mobile (390px) testing on SWIPEUPCAR. Identified & fixed a critical HTML typo (duplicate class= attributes) across 5 files (admin/compte/loueur/pro/location) that prevented .dash-grid/.loc-grid classes from being applied, so all mobile media queries were silently no-op. Also fixed grid tracks stuck on `1fr` (which uses min-content) causing horizontal overflow — replaced with `minmax(0,1fr)!important` in style.css and inline <style> blocks (admin/compte/loueur/pro/vehicule). Added `img{max-width:100%;height:auto}` global. Added 600px breakpoint override for location.html .search-grid (was stuck at 1fr 1fr on mobile). After fixes, 8/9 target pages have zero horizontal overflow at 390px, desktop 1280 unchanged.

ui_bugs.issue: Residual ~92px horizontal overflow at 390px — spec items still render as 2 columns visually and content extends beyond viewport. .stack-sm computed gtc=316px (1 col) but item children have intrinsic width ~205px that don't shrink. Need to enforce `.stack-sm{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important}` at ≤600 without inline override, OR wrap long labels/values. Root cause: inline `style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"` on the .card.stack-sm (line 34) may be creating a specificity/parsing quirk when combined with the media rule.

action_items: Fix residual overflow on vehicule.html specs card at 390px (see ui_bug above). Suggested: change inline style to remove display/grid-template-columns (let CSS class handle it), define .stack-sm base rule in style.css with default 2-col, mobile 1-col.
Consider auditing other pages for similar duplicate `class=` attributes (fixed 5 already: admin/compte/loueur/pro/location).
Consider making `.hide-mobile` breakpoint (860px) align with new 768px mobile rules for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL HTML BUG (fixed): Duplicate `class=` attribute in 5 files (`<div class="container" ... class="dash-grid">`) — browsers ignore the 2nd class attr, so `.dash-grid`/`.loc-grid` never existed on those elements, making all responsive media queries silently no-op. This is why the user saw 'tassé' mobile rendering.

CSS grid `1fr` = `minmax(auto,1fr)` — auto min-content prevents shrinking below content width, causing overflow on mobile when children (tables, images, long text) have large min-content. Always use `minmax(0,1fr)` for main content grids at mobile breakpoints.
Missing global `img{max-width:100%;height:auto}` was causing vehicule mainImg to render at natural width (481px). Fixed.
Inline <style> blocks per-page duplicate media-query logic and can override global style.css rules due to load order; recommend consolidating breakpoints into style.css.

success_rate.frontend: 89% (8/9 pages no-overflow at 390px, all correct desktop 1280)

rca of the issue: Root cause of user complaint 'tassé/écarts bizarres sur mobile': HTML had duplicate `class=` attributes on all dashboard/location container divs (`<div class="container" ... class="dash-grid">`), which browsers parse by keeping only the FIRST occurrence. So `.dash-grid` and `.loc-grid` classes never existed on the DOM elements, and all `@media(max-width:860px){.dash-grid{...}}` rules were dead code. The inline `grid-template-columns:230px 1fr` (or 270px 1fr) forced the desktop 2-column layout to persist on mobile, causing horizontal overflow. Fix: merge the two `class=` attributes into one. Secondary: replace `1fr` with `minmax(0,1fr)` in mobile grid rules to prevent min-content from expanding the grid track.
